name: Ultra Stalker V7.3.1 Hotfix
notes: Ultra Stalker V7.3.1 hotfix for the public V7.3 release. Preserves all approved V7.3 work and fixes the Settings Refresh Content crash by wiring _refresh_current_content into NovaSettingsScreen. Refresh remains source-local for Portal, Xtream and M3U and does not delete persistent artwork, TMDB metadata or title logos.
